title: Helius MEV Centralization Report 2025
text:
Helius MEV Report 2025 - Centralization Risk on Solana

Key findings on MEV and centralization:
- Jito block engine processes ~60% of Solana transactions
- MEV extraction concentrated among top 5 validators
- Sandwich attacks extracted $30M+ in 2024
- Stake concentration: top 20 validators control >33% stake
- Nakamoto coefficient fluctuates between 19-25
- Jito tips create validator revenue concentration
- Private mempool via Jito bundles bypasses public ordering
- MEV bots front-run DEX trades on Raydium, Orca, Jupiter

Attack vectors identified:
- Sandwich: buy before, sell after large swaps
- Arbitrage: cross-DEX price discrepancy exploitation  
- Liquidation MEV: front-run liquidation transactions
- Backrunning: insert profitable trade after large swap

Mitigations:
- Slippage protection in DEX transactions
- Private RPC with transaction privacy
- Jito bundles for atomic execution
- Anti-sandwich DEX designs
- Stake decentralization incentives
Source: Helius MEV Report 2025
